snapshot.stmt: Fix \(C>0\). defs.def:poly-class: \(\mathcal P_{T,\beta}(C)=\{Y:\lvert Y_t(z_{1:t})\rvert\le B\text{ for all }t,z_{1:t},\text{ and }\lvert Y_t(z_{1:t})-Y_t(z'_{1:t})\rvert\le\sum_{\ell=1}^{t-1}C(1+\ell)^{-(1+\beta)}\mathbf1\{z_{t-\ell}\ne z'_{t-\ell}\}\text{ whenever }z_t=z'_t,\ 1\le t\le T\}.
defs.def:design-class: \(\mathcal D_T=\{\pi:\pi_t(\cdot\mid W_{1:t-1},Y_{1:t-1}^{\mathrm{obs}})\text{ is a probability law on }\{0,1\},\ t=1,\ldots,T\}.

snapshot.stmt: Fix \(C>0\). For every \(m<T-1\), \(\mathcal P_{T,\beta}(C)\cap\mathcal F_{T,m}\subsetneq\mathcal P_{T,\beta}(C)\). Let \(a_m=\tfrac12\min\{B,C(2+m)^{-(1+\beta)}\}>0\) and set \(Y_t(z_{1:t})=a_mz_{t-m-1}\) for \(t\ge m+2\) and \(Y_t(z_{1:t})=0\) otherwise. Moreover \(Y_t(z_{1:t})=\sum_{\ell=1}^{t-1}\gamma_\ell z_{t-\ell}\), with \(\gamma_\ell=C(1+\ell)^{-(1+\beta)}/\{2\max[1,(C/B)\sum_{u=1}^{T-1}(1+u)^{-(1+\beta)}]\}\), is bounded, admissible, has positive effects at every lag, and lies outside every prespecified \(\mathcal F_{T,m}\). defs.def:multiscale-design: For each \(b\in\mathcal G_T\), a tag-\(b\) run has length \(2b\), its first \(b\) positions are washout, and its final \(b\) positions are retained. Generate a two-sided equilibrium marked renewal schedule: the run crossing time one has tag probability proportional to \(2bq_b\), a public offset uniform on its \(2b\) positions, and all later tags independently have law \(q_b\); retain its tags, lengths, boundaries, offset, and terminal truncation in \(\mathscr L_T=\sigma(\mathsf S_T)\), but never its arms. Every run \(r\) independently draws \(A_r\sim\mathrm{Bernoulli}(1/2)\), independently of \(\mathscr L_T\), and assigns \(W_t=A_{r(t)}\) at every time through \(T\). At each run start, \(\mathcal F_{r-}=\mathscr L_T\vee\sigma(A_1,\ldots,A_{r-},Y^{\mathrm{obs}}\text{ before run }r)\) and \(\Pr(A_r=a\mid\mathcal F_{r-})=1/2\). Let \(I_{t,b}\) indicate that \(t\) is in the retained tail of a tag-\(b\) run wholly contained in \(\{1,\ldots,T\}\), let \(\mathcal T_b=\{t:I_{t,b}=1\}\), and let \(E_{t,b,a}=I_{t,b}\mathbf1\{A_{r(t)}=a\}\). Compute \(\rho_{t,b}=\Pr(I_{t,b}=1)\), \(p_{t,b,a}=\Pr(E_{t,b,a})=\rho_{t,b}/2\), and \(\rho_{ts,bb'}=\Pr(I_{t,b}=1,I_{s,b'}=1)\) exactly before outcomes by the finite-state recursion \(F_0(0)=1;\ F_{u+1}(d)=\sum_{b'\in\mathcal G_T}q_{b'}F_u((d-1)\bmod 2b')\), augmented with the tag and age state, initialized by the equilibrium tag-offset law, and summed over states that make the displayed indicators one. Thus only indices with \(\rho_{t,b}>0\) are retained. Define \(\widehat\theta_b=T^{-1}\sum_{t\in\mathcal T_b}[\mathbf1(E_{t,b,1})Y_t^{\mathrm{obs}}/p_{t,b,1}-\mathbf1(E_{t,b,0})Y_t^{\mathrm{obs}}/p_{t,b,0}]\); initial-crossing and terminal runs assign arms but contribute zero. For a run \(r=[s_r,e_r]\), set \(h_{t,b}=I_{t,b}(p_{t,b,1}^{-1}+p_{t,b,0}^{-1})\), \(D_{r,t}=0\) for \(t<s_r\) and \(D_{r,t}=\min\{2B,\sum_{u=s_r}^{e_r}C(1+t-u)^{-(1+\beta_-)}\}\) for \(t>e_r\), and \(c_{r,b}=T^{-1}\sum_t h_{t,b}[2B\mathbf1\{t\in[s_r,e_r]\}+D_{r,t}]\). Set \(V_b^{\mathrm{arm}}=\tfrac14\sum_r c_{r,b}^2\), \(V_b^{\mathrm{sched}}=4B^2T^{-2}\sum_{t,s}\lvert\rho_{ts,bb}/(\rho_{t,b}\rho_{s,b})-1\rvert\) over positive-probability retained pairs, and \(\bar V_b=V_b^{\mathrm{arm}}+V_b^{\mathrm{sched}}\). Set \(M_b=\max_r c_{r,b}\), \(R_{T,b}^{\mathrm{bdry}}=8Bb/T\), \(\delta=T^{-2}\), and \(P_b=c_\star\{\sqrt{\bar V_b\log(2K/\delta)}+M_b\log(2K/\delta)\}+R_{T,b}^{\mathrm{bdry}}\). Set \(\Delta_b=\max_{b'\le b}(|\widehat\theta_b-\widehat\theta_{b'}|-P_b-P_{b'})_+\), choose the smallest \(\widehat b\in\arg\min_{b\in\mathcal G_T}(\Delta_b+P_b)\), and output \(\widehat\theta=\widehat\theta_{\widehat b}\). Both \(\widehat b\) and \(\widehat\theta_{\widehat b}\) are \(\mathcal O_T^{\mathrm{ind}}\)-measurable. A required implementation check enumerates this recursion on a toy bounded observed path and evaluates \(\rho,\rho_{ts},\bar V_b,P_b,\widehat b\) without any off-path potential outcome.

snapshot.stmt: Let the scales in \(\mathcal G_T\) be ordered increasingly. Suppose deterministic numbers \(P_b\) are nondecreasing, \(|\widehat\theta_b-\mu_b|\le P_b\), and deterministic biases \(|\mu_b-\theta|\le d_b\) are nonincreasing. Define \[\Delta_b^+=\max_{b'\ge b}(|\widehat\theta_b-\widehat\theta_{b'}|-P_b-P_{b'})_+\] and let \(\widehat b\) minimize \(\Delta_b^++P_b\), with the smallest-minimizer rule. If \(d_{b_*}\le P_{b_*}\), then \[|\widehat\theta_{\widehat b}-\theta|\le6P_{b_*}.\] Thus comparisons must run toward the larger, lower-bias scales; the frozen definition's comparison over \(b'\le b\) has the wrong orientation for the stated bias--variance ordering.

defs.def:scale-grid: For \(T\ge16\), set \(\mathcal G_T=\{2^j:0\le j\le\lfloor\log_2(T/8)\rfloor\}\), \(K=|\mathcal G_T|\), and \(q_b=b^{-1}/\sum_{u\in\mathcal G_T}u^{-1}\). For \(T<16\), set \(\mathcal G_T=\{1\}\), \(K=1\), and \(q_1=1\).

snapshot.stmt: Fix \(C>0\) and let \(\beta_-<\beta_+\). For a prior \(\Pi\) on fixed arrays define \(\mathfrak B_\Pi(\pi,\widehat\theta)=\int\mathbb E_\pi|\widehat\theta-\operatorname{GATE}_T(Y)|\,d\Pi(Y)\). For every \(\pi\in\mathcal D_T\), every estimator \(\widehat\theta\), and every \(\varepsilon\in(0,1)\), there are point-mass priors \(\Pi_-\) and \(\Pi_+\), chosen before assignment and supported respectively on \(\mathcal P_{T,\beta_-}(C)\) and \(\mathcal P_{T,\beta_+}(C)\), such that \[\frac{\mathfrak B_{\Pi_\sigma}(\pi,\widehat\theta)}{R_T(\beta_\sigma;C)}\ge1-\varepsilon\qquad\text{for each }\sigma\in\{-,+\}.\] Consequently \(A_T(C)\ge1\). This establishes only the baseline two-class factor \(g_T=1\); it does not establish a diverging adaptation penalty.

defs.def:multiscale-design: For each \(b\in\mathcal G_T\), a tag-\(b\) run has length \(2b\), its first \(b\) positions are washout, and its final \(b\) positions are retained. Generate a two-sided equilibrium marked renewal schedule: the run crossing time one has tag probability proportional to \(2bq_b\), a public offset uniform on its \(2b\) positions, and all later tags independently have law \(q_b\); retain its tags, lengths, boundaries, offset, and terminal truncation in \(\mathscr L_T=\sigma(\mathsf S_T)\), but never its arms. Every run \(r\) independently draws \(A_r\sim\mathrm{Bernoulli}(1/2)\), independently of \(\mathscr L_T\), and assigns \(W_t=A_{r(t)}\) at every time through \(T\). At each run start, \(\mathcal F_{r-}=\mathscr L_T\vee\sigma(A_1,\ldots,A_{r-},Y^{\mathrm{obs}}\text{ before run }r)\) and \(\Pr(A_r=a\mid\mathcal F_{r-})=1/2\). Let \(I_{t,b}\) indicate that \(t\) is in the retained tail of a tag-\(b\) run wholly contained in \(\{1,\ldots,T\}\), let \(\mathcal T_b=\{t:I_{t,b}=1\}\), and let \(E_{t,b,a}=I_{t,b}\mathbf1\{A_{r(t)}=a\}\). Both \(\widehat b\) and \(\widehat\theta_{\widehat b}\) are \(\mathcal O_T^{\mathrm{ind}}\)-measurable. A required implementation check enumerates this recursion on a toy bounded observed path and evaluates \(\rho,\rho_{ts},\bar V_b,P_b,\widehat b\) without any off-path potential outcome.

snapshot.stmt: Fix \(C>0\), \(\beta\in[\beta_-,\beta_+]\), and \(1\le b\le T\). Let \(\pi^{(b)}\in\mathcal D_T\) initialize \(W_1\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\) and, for \(t\ge2\), switch arms with probability \(1/(b+1)\), independently of outcomes conditional on \(W_{t-1}\). Put \(r_b=b/(b+1)\), \(k_t=\min\{b,t-1\}\), \(H_{t,b,a}=\mathbf1\{W_{t-k_t:t}=\mathbf a\}\), and \(\upsilon_{t,b,a}=\Pr_{\pi^{(b)}}(H_{t,b,a}=1)=\tfrac12r_b^{k_t}\). Define \(q_b=(1+1/b)^b\) and \(\lambda_b=(b-1)/(b+1)\). Then \[\upsilon_{t,b,a}\ge\frac{1}{2q_b}>\frac{1}{2e}.\] The infimum over all admissible \(T,b,t,a\) is \(1/(2e)\), approached but not attained as \(b\to\infty\) along indices with \(k_t=b\). Put \[V_{T,b}^{\sharp}=4\sum_{t=1}^T r_b^{-k_t}+8\sum_{h=1}^b\sum_{t=1}^{T-h}r_b^{-(k_t+k_{t+h})/2}+8\sum_{d=1}^{(T-b-1)_+}(T-b-d)\lambda_b^d,\] with empty inner sums equal to zero, and retain the coarser comparison certificate \[V_{T,b}=4q_bT+8q_b\left(bT-\frac{b(b+1)}2\right)+8\sum_{d=1}^{(T-b-1)_+}(T-b-d)\lambda_b^d.\] The explicit observed-data estimator \[\widehat\vartheta_b=\frac1T\sum_{t=1}^T\left\{\frac{H_{t,b,1}Y_t^{\mathrm{obs}}}{\upsilon_{t,b,1}}-\frac{H_{t,b,0}Y_t^{\mathrm{obs}}}{\upsilon_{t,b,0}}\right\}\] has positive denominators. With \(y_{t,a}=Y_t(\mathbf a_{1:t})\), \[Z_t=\frac{H_{t,b,1}y_{t,1}}{\upsilon_{t,b,1}}-\frac{H_{t,b,0}y_{t,0}}{\upsilon_{t,b,0}},\qquad \widetilde\theta_b=\frac1T\sum_{t=1}^TZ_t,\] one has \[\mathbb EZ_t^2\le4B^2r_b^{-k_t},\qquad |\operatorname{Cov}(Z_t,Z_u)|\le4B^2r_b^{-(k_t+k_u)/2}\quad\text{if }1\le u-t\le b,\] and hence \[\operatorname{Var}\left(\sum_{t=1}^TZ_t\right)\le B^2V_{T,b}^{\sharp},\qquad \mathbb E\left|\widetilde\theta_b-\operatorname{GATE}_T(Y)\right|\le\frac BT\sqrt{V_{T,b}^{\sharp}}.\] Termwise, \[V_{T,b}^{\sharp}<V_{T,b}\le(8e+4)Tb,\qquad 0<V_{T,b}-V_{T,b}^{\sharp}\le12eb^2.\] Consequently \[\lim_{b\to\infty}\lim_{T\to\infty}\frac{V_{T,b}^{\sharp}}{Tb}=8e+4,\] so \(8e+4\) remains the optimal coefficient for a uniform certificate inequality \(V_{T,b}^{\sharp}\le KTb\). Finally, \[\sup_{Y\in\mathcal P_{T,\beta}(C)}\mathbb E_{\pi^{(b)}}\left|\widehat\vartheta_b-\operatorname{GATE}_T(Y)\right|\le U_{T,\beta}^{\sharp}(b)\le\sqrt{8e+4}\,B\sqrt{\frac bT}+\frac{2C}{\beta}\frac{(T-b-1)_+}{T}(b+1)^{-\beta}.\] The quantities \(V_{T,b}^{\sharp}\) and \(E_{T,\beta}^{\sharp}(b)\) are, respectively, a finite variance certificate with exact pair counts and an expected replacement-error upper bound. Neither is asserted to be an exact variance, exact bias, or maximal-bias formula.

Put \(b_-=\lceil T^{1/(2\beta_-+1)}\rceil\) and define \[N_T^{\mathrm{fin}}=\begin{cases}B,&T=1,\\ U_{T,\beta_-}^{\dagger}(b_-),&T\ge2,\end{cases}\qquad N_T^\star=\begin{cases}B,&T=1,\\ \min\left\{2B,\min_{1\le b\le T}U_{T,\beta_-}^{\dagger}(b)\right\},&T\ge2,\end{cases}\] and \[D_T^{\mathrm{bin}}=B2^{-(T-1)}\binom{T-1}{\lfloor(T-1)/2\rfloor}.\] Then, for every \(T\ge1\), \[1\le A_T(C)\le\frac{N_T^\star}{D_T^{\mathrm{bin}}}\le\frac{N_T^{\mathrm{fin}}}{D_T^{\mathrm{bin}}}\le\frac{\sqrt2}{B}\left[\sqrt{(8e-4)\left(1+2^{-1/(2\beta_-+1)}\right)}\,B+\frac{2C}{\beta_-}\right]T^{1/(4\beta_-+2)}.\] At \(T=1\), \[A_1(C)=1,\qquad N_1^\star=N_1^{\mathrm{fin}}=D_1^{\mathrm{bin}}=B.\] This equality is attained by the common fixed-before-assignment rule \(W_1\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\) with \(\widehat\theta_1=(2W_1-1)Y_1^{\mathrm{obs}}\). snapshot.stmt: Fix \(C>0\) and set \[C_0^\star=\sqrt{(8e-4)\left(1+2^{-1/(2\beta_++1)}\right)}\,B+\frac C{\beta_-}.\] Uniformly over \(\beta\in[\beta_-,\beta_+]\), \[\frac{B}{\sqrt{2T}}\le B2^{-(T-1)}\binom{T-1}{\lfloor(T-1)/2\rfloor}\le R_T(\beta;C).\] At \(T=1\), \[R_1(\beta;C)=B,\] attained from above by \(W_1\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\) and \(\widehat\theta_1=(2W_1-1)Y_1^{\mathrm{obs}}\). For \(b\in\{1,\ldots,T\}\), put \(r_b=b/(b+1)\), \(k_t=\min\{b,t-1\}\), \(\lambda_b=(b-1)/(b+1)\), \[V_{T,b}^{\dagger}=4\sum_{t=1}^T r_b^{-k_t}+8\sum_{h=1}^b\sum_{t=1}^{T-h}r_b^{h-k_{t+h}}+8\sum_{d=1}^{(T-b-1)_+}(T-b-d)\lambda_b^d,\] \[E_{T,\beta}^{\mathrm{cond}}(b)=\frac2T\sum_{t=b+2}^T\min\left\{2B,\frac C2\sum_{\ell=b+1}^{t-1}(1+\ell)^{-(1+\beta)}(1-\lambda_b^{\ell-b})\right\},\qquad U_{T,\beta}^{\mathrm{cond}}(b)=\frac BT\sqrt{V_{T,b}^{\dagger}}+E_{T,\beta}^{\mathrm{cond}}(b),\] with empty inner sums equal to zero. Define the integrated finite oracle certificate \[\mathfrak U_{T,\beta}^{\mathrm{cond}}=\begin{cases}B,&T=1,\\ \min\left\{2B,\min_{1\le b\le T}U_{T,\beta}^{\mathrm{cond}}(b)\right\},&T\ge2.\end{cases}\] Put \(b_\beta=\lceil T^{1/(2\beta+1)}\rceil\). snapshot.stmt: Fix \(C>0\), \(\beta\in[\beta_-,\beta_+]\), and \(1\le b\le T\). Let \(\pi^{(b)}\in\mathcal D_T\) initialize \(W_1\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\) and, for \(t\ge2\), switch arms with probability \(1/(b+1)\), independently of outcomes conditional on \(W_{t-1}\). Put \(r_b=b/(b+1)\), \(k_t=\min\{b,t-1\}\), \(H_{t,b,a}=\mathbf1\{W_{t-k_t:t}=\mathbf a\}\), and \(\upsilon_{t,b,a}=\Pr_{\pi^{(b)}}(H_{t,b,a}=1)=\tfrac12r_b^{k_t}\). Define \(q_b=(1+1/b)^b\) and \(\lambda_b=(b-1)/(b+1)\). Then \[\upsilon_{t,b,a}\ge\frac{1}{2q_b}>\frac{1}{2e}.\] The infimum over all admissible \(T,b,t,a\) is \(1/(2e)\), approached but not attained as \(b\to\infty\) along indices with \(k_t=b\). Put \[V_{T,b}^{\dagger}=4\sum_{t=1}^T r_b^{-k_t}+8\sum_{h=1}^b\sum_{t=1}^{T-h}r_b^{h-k_{t+h}}+8\sum_{d=1}^{(T-b-1)_+}(T-b-d)\lambda_b^d,\] with empty sums equal to zero. The explicit observed-data estimator \[\widehat\vartheta_b=\frac1T\sum_{t=1}^T\left\{\frac{H_{t,b,1}Y_t^{\mathrm{obs}}}{\upsilon_{t,b,1}}-\frac{H_{t,b,0}Y_t^{\mathrm{obs}}}{\upsilon_{t,b,0}}\right\}\] has positive denominators. With \(y_{t,a}=Y_t(\mathbf a_{1:t})\), \[Z_t=\frac{H_{t,b,1}y_{t,1}}{\upsilon_{t,b,1}}-\frac{H_{t,b,0}y_{t,0}}{\upsilon_{t,b,0}},\qquad \widetilde\theta_b=\frac1T\sum_{t=1}^TZ_t,\] one has \[\mathbb EZ_t^2\le4B^2r_b^{-k_t}.\] If \(u=t+h\) with \(1\le h\le b\) and \(\rho=2r_b^{h-k_u}\), then \(\rho\ge2\) and \[\operatorname{Cov}(Z_t,Z_u)=(\rho-1)(y_{t,1}y_{u,1}+y_{t,0}y_{u,0})+y_{t,1}y_{u,0}+y_{t,0}y_{u,1},\] so \[|\operatorname{Cov}(Z_t,Z_u)|\le4B^2r_b^{h-k_u}.\] The diagonal and near-pair bounds, and the far-pair bound \(|\operatorname{Cov}(Z_t,Z_u)|\le4B^2\lambda_b^{u-b-t}\) for \(u-t>b\), are attained simultaneously by \(y_{t,0}=y_{t,1}=B\). Consequently \[\sup_{Y\in\mathcal P_{T,\beta}(C)}\operatorname{Var}_{\pi^{(b)}}\left(\sum_{t=1}^TZ_t\right)=B^2V_{T,b}^{\dagger},\qquad \mathbb E\left|\widetilde\theta_b-\operatorname{GATE}_T(Y)\right|\le\frac BT\sqrt{V_{T,b}^{\dagger}}.\] Thus \(B^2V_{T,b}^{\dagger}\) is the exact worst-case auxiliary homogeneous-history variance, not an exact estimator risk. Moreover, \[V_{T,b}^{\dagger}\le4q_bT+8Tb(q_b-1)+4(T-b)(b-1)< (8e-4)Tb,\] \[\lim_{b\to\infty}\lim_{T\to\infty}\frac{V_{T,b}^{\dagger}}{Tb}=8e-4,\] and hence \(8e-4\) is the smallest coefficient in a uniform inequality \(V_{T,b}^{\dagger}\le KTb\). For \(t\ge b+2\), \(\ell\ge b+1\), and \(a\in\{0,1\}\), time reversibility and conditional independence at \(W_{t-b}=a\) give \[\Pr_{\pi^{(b)}}(W_{t-\ell}\ne a\mid H_{t,b,a}=1)=\frac{1-\lambda_b^{\ell-b}}2.\] Define \[E_{T,\beta}^{\mathrm{cond}}(b)=\frac2T\sum_{t=b+2}^T\min\left\{2B,\frac C2\sum_{\ell=b+1}^{t-1}(1+\ell)^{-(1+\beta)}(1-\lambda_b^{\ell-b})\right\}\] and \[U_{T,\beta}^{\mathrm{cond}}(b)=\frac BT\sqrt{V_{T,b}^{\dagger}}+E_{T,\beta}^{\mathrm{cond}}(b).\] Then \[\mathbb E|\widehat\vartheta_b-\widetilde\theta_b|\le E_{T,\beta}^{\mathrm{cond}}(b)\le\frac CT\sum_{\ell=b+1}^{T-1}(T-\ell)(1+\ell)^{-(1+\beta)}(1-\lambda_b^{\ell-b})\le\frac C\beta\frac{(T-b-1)_+}{T}(b+1)^{-\beta}.\] Replacement is zero through \(t=b+1\); empty sums make the formulas valid at \(T=1\), \(b=1\), and \(b=T\). Finally, \[\sup_{Y\in\mathcal P_{T,\beta}(C)}\mathbb E_{\pi^{(b)}}\left|\widehat\vartheta_b-\operatorname{GATE}_T(Y)\right|\le U_{T,\beta}^{\mathrm{cond}}(b)\le\sqrt{8e-4}\,B\sqrt{\frac bT}+\frac C\beta\frac{(T-b-1)_+}{T}(b+1)^{-\beta}.\] The carryover quantity \(E_{T,\beta}^{\mathrm{cond}}(b)\) is an endpoint-aware expected replacement-error upper bound. Neither it nor the complete display is asserted to be an exact bias, maximal carryover error, exact estimator risk, or minimax risk.
